rooms.name: Tser Falls
rooms.desc: The road hugs the mountainside to a high stone bridge, green-black with mould, that leaps a sheer chasm; gargoyles squat on its four corners. Upstream the river pours off the mountain in a white fall and drops out of sight into the mist, a thousand feet to the pool below.
rooms.dm: The chasm walls are slippery and sheer: no climbing without magic or a climber's kit. The bridge is slick but safe. The gargoyles are harmless sculptures. South, the road runs down the mountainside to the crossroads (F); north it cuts through the mountains to the fork (I). The pool below feeds the river past the Tser Pool camp (G).

rooms.name: Falls overlook
rooms.desc: A rocky shelf at the cliff foot, drenched in spray, looking up at the falls.
rooms.dm: This is where Strahd hurled the Mad Mage over the falls, as the Vistani storyteller at G recalls.

objects.label: The chasm
objects.desc: Sheer, wet rock walls drop away into mist. Somewhere far below, the falls thunder into their pool.

objects.label: Tser Falls
objects.desc: The river leaps from the mountainside in a white sheet and falls past you into the misty chasm, sending up cold clouds of spray.

objects.label: Bridge over Tser Falls
objects.desc: A single stone arch leaps the chasm, its stones slick with spray and furred with mould.

objects.label: Moss-cloaked gargoyle
objects.desc: A weathered stone gargoyle crouches on the corner post, shaggy with black moss.
